status: PROPOSED by openspec/changes/leave-station (design 6), on the owner's word of 2026-10-15 ("need a Leave station button", "a key would be nice too"): the key that sits is the key that stands, at every station. Keys by SDL's names. Options > Controls lists this file read-only (openspec/changes/ui-art-direction design 10, Q10: rebinding later); until then it is edited by hand.
_start: openspec/changes/start-mission design 5: START MISSION while the round waits in Muster, for the captain (or any seated person when no person is captain). Return is bound nowhere else in the seated game.

helm._note: Helm's roll moved off E to Z and C (bridge-stations 10.1's keys), and the lateral strafe from Z and C to the arrows; Space and Ctrl still strafe up and down.

viewscreen._note: openspec/changes/chase-orbit design 5: ORBIT on or off while CHASE is on, at every console with a viewscreen. O is bound nowhere else.

captain._note: ui-art-direction design 10: the lighting keys act only from the captain's seat, the ALERT panel's command (owner, 2026-10-15: "lighting can only be changed by the captain").

controls._note: What Options > Controls lists, read-only (ui-art-direction design 10 and its mockup). A key is a binding's field above (@use), a key by its SDL name, a mouse glyph (mouse, click, drag, wheel), hold before a held key, or / between two ways. The keys not yet in the fields above are the client's own (onfoot.rs, seat.rs, drill.rs, main.rs).
